_comment: Deployment contract shared by EVERY variant listed in onnx_variants below - there is deliberately one contract file, not one per network, because the variants agree on the observation layout, the action space, q_default, action_scale, the gains and the rate. That agreement is what lets the controller keep a single observation history and switch networks under it mid-stride, so splitting this into per-variant files would invite the two copies to drift apart and quietly break the hand-over. The controller checks each network's input and output widths against these numbers at load time. Trained with safe_rl/tasks/manager_based/velocity (Rl-Velocity-Aliengo). Joint order is the Isaac 'locosim_joint_names' order, which is identical to conf.robot_params['aliengo']['joint_names'].

notes.normalization: The empirical observation normalizer is baked into the ONNX graph (Sub/Div on 'obs'), so raw observations must be fed.
notes.imu_lin_acc: Isaac ImuCfg.gravity_bias defaults to (0,0,9.81) in world frame, so this term is the specific force measured by a real accelerometer: feed the bias-corrected accelerometer reading, do NOT subtract gravity.
notes.imu_projected_gravity: Unit gravity direction in base frame, b_R_w @ (0,0,-1); level base gives (0,0,-1).
notes.history: Each history block is oldest frame first, newest last, flattened as (history_length, width).
notes.actions: Raw (pre-scale) network outputs of the previous control steps; zeros before the first inference.
notes.onnx_variants: Actors sharing this exact observation/action contract, so the controller can switch between them without disturbing the history. 'normal' tracks the operator velocity command (Rl-Velocity-Aliengo); 'safe' comes from UnitreeAliengoEnvSafeEnvCfg, which is the same env with the command range pinned to zero and far more aggressive reset poses, velocities and pushes - a stand-still recovery policy. Feed 'safe' a zero command, which is the only one it ever saw.
